title: Tool library certification
heading: The tool library, as it stands
lede: A synthetic fixture for the report generator. Every row is a promise of a fictional product, walked in a browser by test users; the dark strip on each screenshot names who is looking and what was read at that instant.
environment: local stack with the seed, two isolated stacks

J01.title: Borrow a tool
J01.summary: A member finds an available tool and asks for it; the steward sees the request.

J02.title: Return and history
J02.summary: Returning frees the tool for others; nobody reads another member's history.

limits.title: Real identity provider.
limits.text: Sign-in used the local stack's simulated provider (case B-08 left out).
